comments.note: CreateWorkPackageSchema title uses z.string() without .min(1) — empty string title ('') passes Zod validation. AC #5 only requires *missing* title to fail (which it does correctly). Consider adding .min(1) for consistency with the acceptance_criteria empty-string guard.
No length cap on description field. As a specification body container this is intentional, but a soft warning or UI-level truncation might be worth considering for very large payloads in future.

comments.note: CreateWorkPackageSchema uses z.string() for title without .min(1) — an empty string title ('') passes Zod validation. The AC only requires missing title to fail (which it does). Adding .min(1) would be a consistent guard matching acceptance_criteria item validation, but changes program behavior so it belongs in a future WP, not a Fix-Forward.

The 'rejects missing title' test (line 3391 work-package.test.ts) validates a local MinimalCreateSchema replica rather than the actual CreateWorkPackageSchema (which is module-private). If someone accidentally marks title optional in the real schema, this test would still pass. Consider exporting CreateWorkPackageSchema for direct test access, or adding a round-trip integration test through the full tool handler path.

[documentation-forward] Gotcha 10b in constraints.md documents the required-title constraint but does not mention that empty string titles are currently accepted (no .min(1) guard). Adding a brief note would prevent future contributors from assuming empty strings are rejected.
